name: Muse Wonder Full
archDisplay: Proprietary multimodal reasoning model (architecture undisclosed); Meta's most capable Muse Wonder variant, 1M-token context
note: The larger Muse Wonder variant, released October 12, 2026 but not offered in the Meta Model API: it is available only inside Muse Code on the $50/month Power Usage and $200/month Maximum Usage plans (dev.meta.ai lists no per-token price), so price is null and apiAvailable false, following the Gemini 4 Argon precedent.
